purpose: MC-RVE counterpart of the SC-RVE constraint-by-capacity study: separate the effect of the convexity and growth constraints from that of network capacity in the MC-RVE gap between the learned constrained energies and the Unconstrained energy.
timing: Frozen on 2026-09-25, after the SC-RVE capacity study and before any MC-RVE capacity fit. The MC-RVE test and path metrics of the m=6 constrained fits and of the 15-model-campaign Unconstrained energy are known; those of the new cells remain closed until their gate.

existing_cells.note: The earlier Unconstrained energy (results/neural_training/free_seed*) followed the 15-model campaign rule; it is retrained here as free_large under the same amendment rule as all other cells.

recipe_in_memory_change: Per cell, models.names is set to the cell model and models.widths[family] to the cell widths; the amendment rule supplies the same active Adam/L-BFGS settings as the m=6 constrained fits.

adam.rule: After at least 2600 Adam steps, stop at a validation check only when the running best validation stress score has failed to improve cumulatively by at least 0.1% over 100 checks and ReduceLROnPlateau has reached the frozen minimum learning rate. Otherwise stop at the 200000-step safety cap. The cap is a resource guard, not a convergence claim.

lbfgs.rule: Start from the best Adam checkpoint. After at least 40 outer calls, stop when the running best validation score has failed to improve cumulatively by at least 0.1% over 30 outer calls. Otherwise stop at the 300-call safety cap.

scheduling: Gate-A fits run first; the ickan_large fits start once no gate-A fit is running, to avoid memory-bandwidth contention. Scheduling does not change any numerical setting.

gates.A: icnn_large, free_small, free_large: all nine fits terminal and verified.
gates.B: ickan_large: its three fits terminal and verified.

evaluation: Every seed of every new cell is evaluated on the 512 test states and the ten held-out paths with protocol/evaluate_final_models.py metrics; tables report the median over seeds, as Table 3 does.

analysis_plan.primary: Independent-test aggregate relative stress error, median over three seeds, per cell.
analysis_plan.ratios: capacity effect (small/large within each row); constraint cost at matched capacity (constrained/unconstrained within each column)
analysis_plan.decision: No reselection from test or path results; how the outcome enters the paper is decided with the author.
